# Usage fixtures

Agent stdout for `TestUsageBreakdownFixtures`, one `<scenario>.jsonl` per
case under `<runner>/<version>/`, with the expected normalized breakdown
(the `usage-breakdown` outputs value) in `<scenario>.json`. The expected
files are written by hand from the runner's documented semantics, not
generated by the code under test.

Provenance: `claude-code/2.1.319/auth-failure-no-api-call.jsonl` is a real
Claude Code 2.1.319 run (a fabricated prompt in an unauthenticated
sandbox), trimmed to the fields the parser reads, with its session and
message ids replaced. Every other fixture is synthetic, built from the
runner's source at the version of its directory:

- Claude Code 2.1.319 (bundled CLI): `result.modelUsage` and
  `total_cost_usd` are cumulative for the session and include subagents,
  compaction and other internal calls; a run can print several results
  (`result_index`), the last one holding the total; `result.usage` is the
  main loop only; assistant lines repeat one message's usage per content
  block.
- Codex 0.167.0 (`codex-rs/exec`): exec prints one `turn.completed` whose
  usage is the thread's running total; `input_tokens` includes cached and
  cache-write input; `output_tokens` includes reasoning; no model, no
  cost; spawned agents' usage is not printed; `turn.failed` and an
  interrupted turn print no usage.
- OpenCode 1.19.5 (`cli/cmd/run.ts`, `session/processor.ts`): each
  `step_finish` is that step's own usage, printed once per part id;
  `tokens.input` excludes cache reads and writes, `tokens.output` excludes
  `tokens.reasoning`; `part.cost` is OpenCode's own estimate; subagent
  sessions and failed steps print no usage; no line names the model.
